headline: Hexagon Nutrition schedules Extraordinary General Meeting for October 28, 2026
summary: Hexagon Nutrition Limited has submitted a formal notice to the exchange regarding an upcoming Extraordinary General Meeting. The meeting of shareholders is scheduled to take place on October 28, 2026. Specific agenda details for the EGM were not disclosed in the initial exchange filing. Retail investors holding shares in the company should monitor subsequent disclosures for the meeting's agenda items.
why_it_matters: Corporate decisions at the EGM may impact shareholder value.
